prompt: What was our average order value in Q1 2026? Answer in one short paragraph without a table.

answer.markdown: In Q1 2026 (January 1, 2026 to March 31, 2026 UTC), Calvin Klein's average order value was 62.50 across 6 qualifying orders (generating a total revenue of 375.00 across 7 purchased items, excluding cancelled and returned items; note that currency is not specified in the database).

evidence.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(sale_price) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders,
  COUNT(item_id) AS total_items,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(sale_price), COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) AS aov
FROM sales
WHERE brand = 'Calvin Klein'
  AND purchased_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND purchased_at < '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
evidence.definitions: scoped-retail-v1; sales contains qualifying item purchases, excluding Cancelled/Returned at both item and order level. transactions contains all current statuses. Revenue uses sale_price; orders and customers require distinct IDs. Brand scope applies before joins and history. purchased_at is the item's created_at. Use UTC half-open periods. Current statuses cannot reconstruct historical status changes. Currency is not specified. Customer geography is available only through query_state_summary.
evidence.purpose: Calculate Calvin Klein average order value in Q1 2026
